description: List the state/year/office combinations this pack actually holds data for, and at which levels (state/county/precinct). Pass state to scope the listing to one state; omit it to see full coverage. Use this before election_results or election_race_summary to check whether a given state/year/office exists before querying it, or to discover what is covered.

state.description: US state, postal code ("PA") or full name ("Pennsylvania"), to scope the listing. Optional.
